purpose: Verify graph-native manoeuvre sequencing, previewed trajectory synthesis, clipping-zone commitment, independent-wheel attitude control, dynamic attitude/path trade-offs, and symmetric precision driving.
guardrails: Python selects only the experimental manoeuvre and transduces exact receipts.
The graph selects phases, target attitude, yaw, speed, path pressure, wheel drive, and wheel braking.
The plant exposes preview geometry but the graph selects clipping zones and converts preview into action.
Slip and path error are objective costs, not fault labels.
All policy constants are named graph attributes or named plant parameters.
